It supports video resolutions up to 1920 x 1200 and 1080p (Full HD), plus flawless audio pass-through for uncompressed digital audio with 7.1, 5.1, or 2 channels.Displayport 1.2a Compliant: Compliant with the DisplayPort 1.2a specification, this cable is also backwards compatible with DisplayPort 1.1/1.1a.
